paper_safe_claim: The pre-specified proposed model is MechSSL-Window Transformer (`ssl_window_transformer/window_level`).
The primary endpoint is patient/record-level macro-F1 under strict patient-wise grouped cross-validation.
Report the proposed model record-level macro-F1, CI, AUROC, PR-AUC, ECE and Brier from the compiled primary table.
If the best model is not the proposed model, describe it as best observed model, not as the pre-specified primary model.
Use ablation results to explain which component contributes most within the proposed model family.
Compare the proposed model against classical and deep-learning baselines; only claim significance if statistical-test CSV supports it.
Report calibration as ECE and Brier; do not rely on discrimination metrics only.
Use repeated grouped CV to discuss robustness across seeds/fold assignments.
Do not call this clinically validated or deployment-ready without external/prospective validation.
